learning_outcomes.text: Practical calculation of structures made of bars and beams.
Numerical finite element modeling of truss and frame structures.
Application of the finite element method to structural calculation.
Concept of discretization and modeling errors.

syllabus_topics: Weak formulation. Matrix writing of equations.
Bar finite element model and application to trusses.
Beam finite element model and application to frames.
Numerical methods applied to finite elements.
Use of a finite element code (Abaqus).
Analysis of finite element model results.
bibliography: Bathe, K. J. (2006). Finite element procedures. Prentice Hall
Batoz, J. L., & Dhatt, G. (1990). Modélisation des structures par éléments finis: Solides élastiques. Presses Université Laval.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
